title: Joyful Irish Tomato Soup
description: A fragrant, silky tomato soup infused with Irish flavors and a botanical twist, perfect for a keto-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the canned diced tomatoes with their juices and the vegetable broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer for 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Using an immersion blender, puree the soup until silky smooth, or transfer to a blender in batches.
Return the soup to the pot, stir in heavy cream, fresh basil, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper, and heat through for 5 minutes without boiling.
Serve hot, garnished with extra basil leaves, and enjoy.
